en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a large multi‑storey academic building complex on a street corner. The architecture is early‑20th‑century, with stone base, plastered upper floors, and a towered section further along the street. Trees and lampposts line the road. At the bottom of the image the words "Pécs" and "Központi Egyetem" are printed. The reverse side contains handwritten Hungarian text in blue ink, a Hungarian postage stamp, a circular postmark, and printed postcard layout elements.
